title: Kept outreach going remotely, with about 2,125 participants in seven months
summary: When work went remote in 2020, I moved the connect program online and kept measuring it. Between February and August the sessions reached about 2,125 participants across 12 cities and more than 40 departments.
what_would_have_happened: Outreach would have stalled when offices closed.
the_call: Move everything online and keep measuring reach monthly.
what_i_did: Ran and tracked the connects monthly by city, role and department, and reported the numbers for the team's KPIs.
what_changed: The numbers went into the team's KPI reporting, and the sessions led to three teams going live on quality gates and two adding mutation testing to their pipelines.
